overview:
NY-16 is a heavily Democratic Westchester-area seat where first-term incumbent George Latimer is seeking re-election. The district's +18 Democratic lean, combined with incumbency advantages, makes a Republican takeover very unlikely under normal conditions.

Republican challenger Joseph Cinquemani has reported no fundraising and no outside groups are active in the race. Prediction markets give Latimer roughly a 96% chance of winning. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, which point to a comfortable Democratic victory in the mid-20-point range.
